# Week of Data

> Week of Data is a planned week of data community events in one location. It has no date or location yet: once the Luma calendar reaches 100 subscribers, the week and city are chosen with the subscribers and announced on the calendar.

## Links

- Calendar: https://luma.com/weekofdata
- Books: https://weekofdata.com/books/
- Events running now: https://luma.com/DataLakehouseHub and https://luma.com/agenticlakehouse
- Organizer: Alex Merced (https://alexmerced.com)
- Community hub: https://datalakehousehub.com
- Contact: WeekOfData@DataLakehouseHub.com

## How to Participate

Subscribe to the calendar on Luma. Once the week is determined, you can have your data event added to the official calendar by emailing WeekOfData@DataLakehouseHub.com.
